office_does: The assessor values all taxable property in Skagit County for property taxes, revaluing it every year and inspecting each property at least once every six years, and runs the senior and disability tax exemption program.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Assessor Danny Hagen (Prefers Independent Party), elected in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Skagit County Assessor since 2022 after eight years in the Assessor's Office; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Elected Assessor in 2022 after eight years in the office; president of the state county assessors' association [S1]
Promotes the expanded senior and disability property tax exemption under ESSB 6162, raising the income limit to $78,000 [S1]
Says the assessor's office should not be partisan and runs as an Independent [S4]
